data.name: Mahdeeya
data.gender_notes: Mahdeeya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'hada' meaning 'to guide'. This name is given to a girl who is considered a guide or a helper to others. The name Mahdeeya carries the meaning “Guided One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahdeeya usually hope their child will grow to embody guided one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the concept of the Mahdi, the divinely guided leader who will restore justice and peace to the world.
data.etymology: Mahdeeya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guided One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahdeeya total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: مهدية
in_arabic.meaning: هدايت یافتہ، راہ دکھائی ہوئی، سیدھے راستے پر چلنے والی
in_arabic.long_meaning: مهدية اسم ہے جو مہد سے ماخوذ ہے، یعنی وہ شخص جس کی راہ دکھائی گئی ہو یا جو سیدھے راستے پر چل رہا ہو۔ یہ نام اسلامی عقیدت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر مہدی کے حوالے سے جو آخر زمانہ میں ظاہر ہونے والا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: مہدیہ
in_urdu.meaning: هدايت یافتہ، راہ دکھائی ہوئی، سیدھے راستے پر چلنے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: مہدیہ نام مہد سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے هدايت يا راہ دکھانا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں خاص اہمیت کا حامل ہے، کیونکہ مہدی ایک ایسا شخص ہے جو آخر زمانہ میں ظاہر ہو گا اور زمین پر انصاف قائم کرے گا۔

in_hindi.name: मेहदिया
in_hindi.meaning: निर्देशित, मार्गदर्शित, सीधे रास्ते पर चलने वाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: मेहदिया नाम मेहद से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है मार्गदर्शन या निर्देशन। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है, खासकर मेहदी के संदर्भ में जो अंत समय में प्रकट होने वाला है।

in_pashto.name: مهديه
in_pashto.meaning: لارښودنه شوي، هدايت شوي، په سمه لاره روان
in_pashto.long_meaning: مهديه د مہد څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی، چې د لارښودنې یا هدايت معنی لري. دا نوم د اسلامي پيروۍ کې مهم دی، په ځانګړي ډول د مہدي په اړه چې په آخر وخت کې څرګندېږي.

in_english.name: Mahdeeya
in_english.meaning: Guided, directed, one who follows the right path
in_english.long_meaning: Mahdeeya is derived from the Arabic root 'Mahdi', meaning guided or directed. In Islamic eschatology, the Mahdi is a figure who will appear at the end of times to bring justice and righteousness. The name signifies spiritual guidance, righteousness, and adherence to the true path.

In many Islamic communities, naming a child this name is reflective of their hopes and aspirations for her to grow up to be a woman of guidance and support for her community. This name is often given to young girls who display qualities of maturity, wisdom, and compassion.

By bestowing the name Mahdeeya upon a child, parents are expressing their desire for her to fulfill this important role not only within her community but also within her own family, and ultimately in her relationship with Allah (God). This name serves as a constant reminder for the girl to strive for personal growth and to use her unique gifts and talents to make a positive impact on those around her, ultimately fulfilling the higher purpose of pleasing Allah.
